parameters.name: BatchCode
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the batch. You can obtain this value by calling the [QuerySoundCodeLabelBatchList](~~424329~~) operation.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
